comments.author: Hhyymmm
comments.body_html: How should I set it up to change ODIN’s hatred and make it fire at the Black Legion? In my settings, the adjacent wedge and the one here both start by directly attacking me. However, there is no combat between them (in fact, ODIN will have a hostile reaction to the black legion soldiers generated in WTT - Black Division, but will not have a hostile reaction to the bots generated in WEDGE).

comments.author: S4LCO
comments.body_html: Odin’s hostility settings cannot be changed and are hard-coded. Odin will only fire at other bots if he feels actively threatened or is attacked first. Odin is currently the strongest bot in existence. If he were hostile towards other bots, the server would quickly be emptied, which defeats the whole purpose.
